mapper.insert: INSERT INTO arc (story_id, title, goal, target_start_chapter, target_end_chapter, status) VALUES (#{storyId}, #{title}, #{goal}, #{targetStartChapter}, #{targetEndChapter}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'PLANNED'))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM arc WHERE story_id = #{storyId} ORDER BY target_start_chapter ASC
SELECT FROM arc WHERE story_id = #{storyId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE arc SET title = #{title}, goal = #{goal}, target_start_chapter = #{targetStartChapter}, target_end_chapter = #{targetEndChapter}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE arc SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
